title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
summary: LVMH’s Media Division and Open AI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through Chat GPT.

title: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch £1m partnership
summary: The King’s Trust and Open AI launch a £1m partnership to help up to 25,000 young people across the UK build practical AI skills for work.
